# Chauncy's Automotive

> Chauncy's Automotive is a family-run auto repair shop in Amarillo, Texas, owned by Chauncy Hanke, offering maintenance, oil changes, alignments, steering and suspension, and tire service.

## Key facts
- Business: Chauncy's Automotive
- Owner: Chauncy Hanke
- Location: 2001 Paramount Blvd, Amarillo, TX 79109
- Specialties: auto maintenance, oil changes, wheel alignment, steering & suspension, tire service, fluid flushes
- Rating: 4.5 stars from 260 Google reviews
- Community: donated a van to Hope Lives Here, a veterans organization
- Member: Amarillo Chamber of Commerce
- Phone: (806) 463-3149
- Address: 2001 Paramount Blvd, Amarillo, TX 79109
- Hours: Mon – Fri 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM; Sat – Sun Closed
- Services: Auto Maintenance, Oil Changes, Wheel Alignment, Steering & Suspension, Tire Service, Fluid Flushes
